ammonia.reason: Negligible deamination with no ripening and low proteolysis in fresh whey protein.

animal_barnyard.reason: Minimal p-cresol/indole from sheep-goat whey diluted by high-heat treatment.

bitter.reason: Few hydrophobic bitter peptides due to no rennet and no extended proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone methyl ketones formed.

browning.reason: High 71% moisture and no aging limits Maillard despite residual lactose plus lysine.

buttery.reason: Low diacetyl/acetoin from minimal citrate fermentation and low 14% fat.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Very low butyric/isovaleric acids with no rennet lipolysis and fresh age.

creaminess.reason: High moisture plus denatured whey protein and fat globules give creamy spoonable paste.

crumbliness.reason: Grainy aggregated albumin ricotta-like curd fractures short without elasticity.

firmness.reason: Very high moisture heat-precipitated whey gel is soft and spreadable.

floral_honey.reason: Very low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism when fresh.

fruity.reason: Virtually no ethyl butanoate/hexanoate esters without aging or esterase activity.

goaty.reason: Low caproic/caprylic/capric acids from sheep-goat whey fat with minimal lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: No aged Strecker aldehydes like 3-methylbutanal or pyrazines with 0 months aging.

melt.reason: Denatured whey proteins lack intact casein network so softens but does not flow.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleate oxidation suppressed by 85-90C whey heating.

oil_off.reason: Low 14% fat entrapped in whey protein matrix releases almost no free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make; no guaiacol/syringol smoke phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: Moderate lactic acid with trace acetic acid from LAB at pH 5.0.

stretch.reason: No intact para-casein or pasta-filata step; acid-heat curd cannot stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Beta-lactoglobulin denaturation at 85-90C releases H2S and cooked-milk sulfides.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose and whey sweetness enhanced by low 0.9% salt.

umami.reason: Very low free glutamate without proteolysis or aging.
